gold.user: A project manager looking to retrieve the current statuses of issues in a Jira project.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all available statuses in the Jira instance.

gold.user: An administrator creating a new status for the workflow in Jira.
gold.ideal: Creates a new status and returns the details of the created status.

gold.user: A team lead updating an existing status to reflect a change in the workflow.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified status and returns the updated status details.

gold.user: A developer checking which issue types are associated with a specific status in a project.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of issue types that use the specified status in the given project.

gold.user: A product owner wanting to find the ID of a status by its name.
gold.ideal: Returns the status ID(s) for the specified status name(s).

gold.user: A business analyst searching for specific statuses based on criteria.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of statuses that match the search criteria.

gold.user: A project coordinator wanting to see where a specific status is used across projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of projects that utilize the specified status.

gold.user: A workflow designer analyzing how a status is integrated into various workflows.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of workflows that include the specified status.

gold.user: An administrator removing an obsolete status from the system.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified status and confirms the deletion.
